cells.readout: cap hits (finish reason = length at 16,384 tokens) among the 250 answers
cells.why: In f2-m03 the dose multiplies a per-position stop hazard. The hard328 dial (77, 46, 25, 5 cap hits) puts survival at size 2 near S^3 to S^5, so MATH-500's roughly 25/500 base cap hits fall to about 1 of 250. The rival has no finishing policy: an arm about as strong as RL keeps RL-like cap hits on MATH-500's long problems (about 10-14 of 500), i.e. about 6 of 250.

cells.readout: problems among the 240 whose v3 score in this run differs from the stored Code-RL cue row for the same problem (job a619)
cells.why: In f2-m04 each run is an independent Bernoulli draw with spread sqrt(sum p(1-p)) of about 6 on hard328, so two draws differ on 2 x 36 x 240/328 = 53 problems, and the same seed adds nothing. run-08/f2-m01 puts the hard328 sampling SD at 7-9 from fixed per-problem fork probabilities, i.e. sum p(1-p) of about 64, so 2 x 64 x 240/328 = 94 problems differ.

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model think_sft --prompt cue --set hard328 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --min-p 0.1 --seed 3000000 --n 120 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)
cells.readout: answers among the 120 whose generated text switches into a non-Latin script (the switch rule of analysis/drift.py, result-997be4)
cells.unit: answers with a script switch, of 120
cells.why: f2-m05 has drift come from sampling an off-distribution tail under a foreign template, and a sharper next-token distribution drifts less. min-p 0.1 cuts that tail, so the stored raw-template rate (156 of 1,312 samples, 14 per 120) falls to about 4. run-03/f2-m05 ties the degeneration hazard to tokens already generated (first switch near token 13,600), not to the sampler, so the rate stays at about 14 per 120.
